Case: Which Friday?

attestedBadr was on a Friday morning, the seventeenth of Ramaḍān. (section 335, vol. 1, p. 239)

attestedThe battle of Badr fell on a Friday morning, the 17th of Ramaḍān. (section 934, vol. 1, p. 625)

attestedThe Prophet finished with Badr at the end of Ramaḍān or in Shawwāl. (section 1165, vol. 2, p. 43)

  • computedbefore lunation: Monday 13 February 624
  • computedtabular lunation: Tuesday 13 March 624
  • computedafter lunation: Thursday 12 April 624

The weekday in the text and the computed weekday are kept apart. A mismatch is a question for the scholars, never a correction.
